bg-floating.$description: The ELEVATED surface: menus, popovers, dialogs. White in light mode; one ladder step ABOVE surface in dark mode, because in dark mode elevation is lightness, not shadow. Follows neutral-2 (light) / neutral-3 (dark). Restored unreleased December intent, 2026-08-29.

com.equinor.eds.gamut.note: Cannot be expressed in sRGB. The fallback holds lightness and hue and lowers chroma, so the family keeps a shared lightness at this step.
